profile.title: Professional Profile
profile.body: Systems Engineer with over 20 years of technical experience. Expert in server infrastructure, local virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V) and Cloud (Azure) environments, information assurance, and functional consulting for ERPs (SAP Business One) and CRMs. Focused on continuous optimization and creating resilient IT architectures.

about.title: About Me
about.body: Beyond servers and infrastructure, I apply my analytical focus and passion for problem-solving to various personal interests. I enjoy understanding how systems work from the inside out, whether it's a motorcycle engine, the precision of a classic watch, or the statistics behind a sporting event.
